mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.category_id, r.type, r.description, r.image, r.location, r.total_count, r.status, r.audit_reason, r.create_time, r.update_time, c.name AS category_name FROM `resource` r LEFT JOIN `category` c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, category_id, type, description, image, location, total_count, status, audit_reason, create_time, update_time FROM `resource` WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `resource` (name, category_id, type, description, image, location, total_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{description}, #{image}, #{location}, #{totalCount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `resource` SET status = #{status}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
